title: SoundGate Guitar
claim: Product Hunt: SoundGate Guitar — AI Music Tutor that gives real-time feedback on your playing
why_good: SoundGate Guitar is an AI-powered music tutor that provides immediate feedback on guitar playing, helping users improve their skills effectively.
value: Beginner guitarists are the primary buyers, seeking a tool that offers immediate feedback to accelerate their learning.
risk: The risk lies in established platforms like Yousician, which already dominate the market with comprehensive music learning solutions.
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score
does: SoundGate listens through the phone mic while you play and reacts in the moment: which note you actually hit, whether the chord rang clean, whether you drifted off the beat.
why_use: Users often complain about traditional music lessons being too rigid and lacking instant feedback, which SoundGate Guitar addresses with its real-time analysis.
gap: Every big guitar app (Yousician, Simply Guitar, Fender Play) sells a curriculum and grades you against ITS songs. Nobody grades you against the song you already chose to learn — the one you looked up a tab for last night. The listening layer is finally cheap enough to be decoupled from the course.
counter: Pitch detection on a strummed six-string chord is genuinely hard, and the incumbents have had years of audio engineering on it; a thin wrapper over a generic pitch library will be heard as wrong within one session and never opened again.
differentiator: Don't ship a course. Ship the ear: point it at any tab or YouTube lesson the learner already has open, and just tell them which bar they keep fluffing. Cold start CN = 小红书/B站 '吉他自学' 打卡帖下面的评论区 (人们在那里贴自己的录音求点评); EN = r/guitarlessons weekly 'critique my playing' threads.
hook: Adults teaching themselves guitar from an app hit the same wall on day thirty: the app can play at them but cannot look at them. They post a phone video to strangers and wait a day to find out whether their hand is in the wrong place.

zh.claim: 渴望学习吉他的音乐爱好者在演奏时难以获得实时反馈，导致挫败感和进步缓慢。
zh.hook: 买了吉他、跟着 YouTube 学会四个和弦然后卡住的成年人——因为没人在旁边告诉他「那根弦你按闷了」。
zh.does: SoundGate 用手机麦克风边听边反应：你实际按到的是哪个音、和弦响没响干净、有没有拖拍。
zh.why_use: 用户常常抱怨传统音乐课程过于死板，缺乏即时反馈，而 SoundGate Guitar 则通过实时分析解决了这一问题。
zh.gap: 大厂吉他 App（Yousician / Simply Guitar / Fender Play）卖的是课程，只拿它自己的曲库给你打分。没有人对着「你昨晚自己搜到那份谱」打分。而听力这一层现在便宜到可以从课程里拆出来单卖。
zh.counter: 扫弦六根弦的音高识别是真难，几家老牌在音频工程上磨了很多年；随便包一层通用 pitch 库，用户第一节课就听得出它判错，然后再也不打开。
zh.differentiator: 不要做课程，只做那只耳朵：对准学习者本来就打开着的任何一份谱或教学视频，只告诉他哪一小节反复弹错。冷启动：中文＝小红书/B站「吉他自学」打卡帖的评论区（人们在那里贴自己的录音求点评）；英文＝r/guitarlessons 每周的 critique-my-playing 帖。
zh.value: 初学者吉他手是主要买家，寻求能够提供即时反馈以加速学习的工具。
zh.risk: 风险在于像 Yousician 这样的成熟平台，已经在市场上占据主导地位，提供全面的音乐学习解决方案。
zh.why_good: SoundGate Guitar 是一款 AI 驱动的音乐导师，能够提供吉他演奏的即时反馈，帮助用户有效提高技能。
zh.consumer_angle: 有真吉他、没老师的成年初学者；成品是每次练完的一句话——你反复卡在哪一小节。
zh.edge: 它按「你自己已经挑好的那首歌」来评你——昨晚你翻出来的那份谱——而不是按课程表里的曲目。现有产品没有一个这么做，因为课程本身就是它们的生意。

voices.text: I would love to have an instructor, Rocksmith can teach things but It can't see my hooftips and coach me in not sucking.
voices.source: r/guitarlessons — 'Newbie, not sure if I'm setting myself up for success.'

voices.text: I realised the g sting is the only one which isn't giving crisp sound. All other gives. How important is it that the g string gives crisp sound? Should I change my hand placement or continue with my current hand placement. I have no teacher.
Palm muting. Am I doing this right? Maybe not great amp settings?

consumer_angle: Self-taught adult beginners with a real guitar and no teacher; the deliverable is one sentence per practice session naming the bar they keep missing.
edge: It grades you against the song you already chose to learn — the tab you looked up last night — instead of against a curriculum's song list. No incumbent does this, because the curriculum is the incumbent's business.
